title: Averaging principle for a slow-fast stochastic nonlinear fractional Schrödinger equation
summary: We establish an averaging principle for a structural multiscale stochastic nonlinear fractional Schrödinger system on the one-dimensional torus driven by a multiplicative Wiener noise. The slow component is governed by a fractional Schrödinger operator with a general polynomial nonlinearity, while the fast component evolves on a shorter time scale and exhibits dissipative diffusion, nonlinear interactions, and stochastic forcing.
